titleStmt.title: The Secretary General of the League of Nations (Drummond) to President Harding

div.head: The Secretary General of the League of Nations (Drummond) to President Harding
div.p: as defined by the Council of the League of Nations at its meeting on December 17th, 1920.
In execution of the final provisions of the said Mandates, such certified copies are being forwarded to all Powers Signatories of the Treaty of Peace with Germany.
At the meeting of the Council at which the terms of these Mandates were defined, it was understood that the English text only was to be considered authentic.

note.p: Not printed; the same, mutatis mutandis, as the mandate for “German Possessions in the Pacific Ocean Situated South of the Equator, Other Than German Samoa and Nauru”, infra.
